description: Render one exact query template and named market through reviewed Windows mcdev 10.1.0 buildDefinition. Requires static JSON with a literal safe key, restricted simple SQL market substitutions and explicitly disabled buildDefinition validation hooks. Writes or overwrites the key-named JSON/SQL pair in all configured project-contained templateBuilds destinations, with purge explicitly off. Ordinary native SDK initialization and authentication/session/network effects are accepted native behavior, not a local-only guarantee. Caller must maintain external project/path quiescence through preparation and settlement; the shared server guard does not lock other processes. Request cancellation is best-effort; partial effects and unknown termination are possible. No automatic retry or rollback. No custom consent form or repeated confirmation; ordinary host tool approval applies. Returns bounded per-destination observations, never raw output or secrets. Exit zero and local materialization do not prove artifact or remote completeness, invocation causality or language validation. Dynamic JSON keys and JSON templating are unavailable; this does not execute or activate SQL.
name: render_mcdev_query_definition
